title: Alumini Connect
description: Alumni Connect is a full-stack web application built using the MERN stack designed to bridge the gap between alumni and current students of an institution. The platform enables seamless networking, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the college community.

title: Connectly
description: Connectly is a real-time video conferencing web application built using modern web technologies, enabling seamless communication through video, audio, and chat. The platform allows users to create or join virtual meeting rooms and interact with others in real-time, making it ideal for online meetings, remote collaboration, and virtual classrooms.

title: MockZerodha
description: About MockZerodha trading platform built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). This project simulates the core functionalities of an online trading platform, including user authentication, stock market data display, and portfolio management.
